The Old Railway Bridge is a bridge in Belgrade, the capital of Serbia, spanning the Sava River. This bridge was the first railway bridge in Belgrade and remained the only railway bridge in Belgrade until 1935. During the two World Wars, the Old Railway Bridge was demolished.

input: The Barris Bridge , also known as the New Bridge , is a bridge in Perigueux, Dordogne, Nouvelle-Aquitaine, France.

The Starlight Bridge is a pedestrian-only bridge located in Xizhi District, New Taipei City. It spans the Keelung River, with a total length of 270 meters and a width of 8.6 to 9.1 meters. It connects the first section of Xiangzhang Road and the Jiangzhang Pumping Station in New Taipei City, and was completed on October 31, 2014.

Jining Road Baptist Church is a church in Qingdao City, Shandong Province, People's Republic of China. It was built in 1928 and was established by the Southern Baptist Convention. It is located on the hillside of No. 31 Jining Road  in the North District of the city, and is a magnificent neoclassical style building.

input: Star Mosque, Bengali Pinyin Taramasjid, is a mosque in Dhaka, Bangladesh. The mosque uses blue star patterns for decoration and was built in the first half of the 19th century.
Otani Temple is a Shingon sect temple of the Toyama school in Nagaokakyo City, Kyoto Prefecture. It is known to people as the Temple of Peony.
The Vincennes Stadium is a cycling stadium in the Vincennes Forest in Paris, France. This stadium was the main stadium for the 1900 Summer Olympics and the cycling venue for the 1924 Summer Olympics.

The Kaohsiung Municipal International Swimming Pool, formerly known as the Kaohsiung Municipal International Standard Swimming Pool, is located at No. 1, Lane 94, Zhongzheng 1st Road, Lingya District, Kaohsiung City, adjacent to Zhongzheng Sports Field and Zhongzheng Martial Arts Hall. It was completed in April 1996 and has a seating capacity of 3000 people. The swimming pool is a venue for swimming, diving, and water ballet competitions. During the 2009 World Games, it was the competition venue for fin swimming and water rescue events.

input: Nahanni National Park Reserve, located in the northwest region of Canada, is about 500 kilometers west of the capital, Yellowknife. The main purpose is to protect some natural areas of the Mackenzie Mountains.

The Chini Mosque is a mosque in Soidpur city, Nilphamari district, Rangpur division, Bangladesh. This mosque is also known as the Glass Mosque. The construction of the mosque began in 1863, built by Haji Bakar Ali Ahmed, and was completed within a year.
Luoshe Station is a railway station on the Beijing-Shanghai line, located in Luoshe Town, Huishan District, Wuxi City, Jiangsu Province, with a postal code of 214187.
Hirohara Station is located in Takaharu Town, Nishimoro County, Miyazaki Prefecture, and is a station on the Yoshito Line of Kyushu Passenger Railway .

Asen's Fortress is a medieval fortress in the Rhodope Mountains of Bulgaria, located 2 to 3 kilometers  south of Asenovgrad, with an altitude of 279 meters . The best preserved part of the fortress is the Church of the Virgin Mary.
Glasgow Bridge, also known as Jamaica Bridge, is a bridge in the center of Glasgow that spans the Clyde River. It is located near Glasgow Central Station and carries Jamaica Street.

The Great Lavra Bell Tower is a bell tower of the Kiev Pechersk Lavra in Kiev, the capital of Ukraine, and it is also one of the most famous landmarks in the Kiev skyline. Between 1731 and 1745, this bell tower was the tallest freestanding bell tower in the world.

input: Velenje Castle (Slovenian: Velenjski grad) is a well-preserved castle located in the Slovenian city of Velenje. The castle is now used as an art and culture museum. Velenje Castle was mentioned as early as 1270.

Mosna Castle is a historic castle and residence in Poland, located in the southwestern Polish village of Mosna. This castle is one of the most famous monuments in the Upper Silesia region and is often listed among the most beautiful castles in the world. The castle was built in the 17th century.

input: Jingmiao Temple is a Rinzai Zen temple located in Arida City, Wakayama Prefecture. The mountain name is Medicine King Mountain. The main deity is the Medicine Buddha. In the temple area located in the mountain belly, there are now buildings from the Middle Ages such as the main hall  and the pagoda.

Trakai Castle is a castle in Lithuania, located in the town of Trakai in the Ukmerge district of central Lithuania. The castle overlooks Lake Trakai and was built in the 16th century in the Renaissance style. Since 1990, the castle has been undergoing reconstruction.
Kasperk Castle is a medieval castle in the southwest of Bohemia . This castle is the highest-ranking royal castle in Bohemia, located on a peak of 886 meters . Kasperk Castle was built in 1356.

input: The Europa-Center is a complex located at Breitscheidplatz in Berlin, Germany, which includes a shopping center and a building constructed from 1963 to 1965, with a height of 86 meters .

The Shanghai No.1 Intermediate People's Court (also known as: Shanghai First Intermediate Court, Shanghai Intermediate Court, Hu First Intermediate Court; official document code: Hu First Intermediate) is an intermediate people's court in Shanghai, People's Republic of China, located at No. 1200 Hongqiao Road, Changning District, Shanghai.

The site of the Town West Japanese Invasion Airport, located in Town West, Chaganhaote Tourism Economic Development Zone, Baicheng City, Jilin Province, China, is a provincial-level cultural relic protection unit. The type is modern architecture, and the announcement time is May 31, 2007. This cultural relic protection unit is managed by the Taobei District Cultural Management Office. The historical age of the Town West Japanese Invasion Airport site is 1938.

input: Zhao Shan Avenue is a planned main urban road located in Tongzhou District, Beijing, China, extending east to Jian Yun Gou. It is part of the "Yudai River Avenue - Zhao Shan Avenue" horizontal passage in the "Eleven Horizontal and Nine Vertical" road network system of Beijing's urban sub-center.

Traktor Ice Arena is an indoor ice arena located in Chelyabinsk, Russia. It is used for various indoor activities and is also the home field for the KHL team Chelyabinsk Tractor and the MHL team Chelyabinsk Polar Bears.

Duwen Temple, a Tiantai Buddhist temple in Tarumi Ward, Kobe City, Hyogo Prefecture, Japan. The mountain is called Jixiang Mountain, and the main deity worshipped is Bishamonten. Because of the Benten Pond Bridge and Swallow Flower in the temple, it is considered one of the "famous places for flowers in Kobe".

input: St. Peter's Cathedral  is the cathedral of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Trier, with a length of 112.5 meters  and a width of 41 meters . It is located in Trier, Germany, and is the oldest cathedral in Germany. This long-lived building has experienced several centuries, blending design elements from different generations. In 1986, it became a World Heritage Site designated by UNESCO along with other ancient Roman sites in Trier.

The Art Bridge is a pedestrian bridge over the Vardar River in the center of Skopje, the capital of North Macedonia. The feature of the Art Bridge is that it is decorated with numerous statues of famous Macedonian artists and musicians. The Art Bridge is part of the Skopje 2014 project and cost 2.5 million euros to build.

The Toronto Transit Commission provides several public transportation services in the city center, including two subway lines  and surface trams. In addition, the GO Transit company also provides commuter rail services connecting the Union Station in the city center with suburban towns. There are two highways in the area, namely the east-west Gardiner Expressway and the north-south Don Valley Parkway, both of which are managed by the transportation department of Toronto.

Ningjiang Mosque, located in Ningjiang District, Songyuan City, Jilin Province, China, is a provincial-level cultural relic protection unit. The type is ancient architecture, and the announcement time is May 31, 2007. This cultural relic protection unit is managed by Ningjiang District Cultural Management Office. The historical era of Ningjiang Mosque is the Qing Dynasty.

Peñafiel Castle is a castle located in the city of Peñafiel in the province of Valladolid, Spain. The castle is 150 meters  long and 10 meters  wide. The castle was listed as a national monument by the Spanish government in 1917.

Gniew Castle is a castle in Poland. This castle was built after 1290 and once belonged to the Teutonic Knights. The castle has been expanded many times in history. In the late 20th century, Gniew Castle was rebuilt.

Lubart's Castle, also known as Lutsk Castle or Upper Castle, is a castle located in the Ukrainian city of Lutsk, its history can be traced back to the mid-14th century. The castle is one of the most famous landmarks in Lutsk and appears in the design of the 200 Ukrainian hryvnia banknote.

On July 23, 1982, it was announced as a cultural relics protection unit of Hebei Province, with the type of ancient tombs. In the Tou Dao Ying Zi Village under the jurisdiction of Bei Wushi Jia Zi Town, there is the tomb of the eldest daughter of Emperor Jingzong of the Liao Dynasty, the Grand Princess of Qin and Jin, which is one of the projects of the Ba Wang Gou Tomb Group. According to the epitaph of the princess, this place is the ancestral tomb of her husband Xiao Jixian's family.

input: Ostrih Castle is a castle building located in the western Ukrainian city of Ostrih. From the 14th to the 16th century, the castle was one of the main strongholds of the Ostroh family. Now only ruins of the castle remain.

Makomanai Open Stadium, is a stadium located in Makomanai Park, Minami Ward, Sapporo City, Hokkaido, Japan. The stadium was opened in February 1971 and can accommodate 17,324 people. It was used as the main stadium for the 1972 Winter Olympics.

The Hospital Front Street Church, originally known as the Truth Church, is a church in Kaifeng City, Henan Province, China. It was established by the Canadian Anglican Church in 1931 and is located on the Hospital Front Street in the South Gate of Kaifeng. It can accommodate 500 people and is one of the two parishes set up by the church in Kaifeng, along with the Trinity Church. It was closed in 1958 and worship was resumed in 1983. The church is the oldest existing Protestant church in Kaifeng and can no longer accommodate the current 1500 believers.

input: Independence Square, formerly known as Republic Square, is a square in the center of Podgorica, the capital of Montenegro, located in New Podgorica. The area of Independence Square is 15,000 square meters, and the city library and the national art gallery are both located here.

The Shijiazhuang Railway Museum, which is planned to be located in the railway museum of the second generation station building of China Railway Shijiazhuang Station, is located on the east side of Liberation Square in Qiaoxi District, Shijiazhuang City, Hebei Province, China.
Risshaku-ji is a Tendai Buddhist temple located in Yamagata City, Yamagata Prefecture, Japan. It is also known by the name Yamadera.
The Artillery Museum, officially known as the Military History Museum of Artillery, Engineer and Signal Corps, is a military museum located in Saint Petersburg, Russia.

input: Mitsu-do Temple is a temple located in Uji City, Kyoto Prefecture, Japan. Its mountain name is Myojyo Mountain, and its principal deity is the Thousand-Hand Kannon. It is the tenth place of worship in the Saigoku 33 Kannon Pilgrimage and is a separate mountain of the Honzan Shugen sect.

Tsarevets Fortress is a medieval fortress located in Veliko Tarnovo in northern Bulgaria. The building was the most important fortress of the Second Bulgarian Empire from 1185 to 1393, and now it is a popular tourist attraction.
Perm Bolshoye Savino Airport  is an international airport primarily serving Perm, Russia, located 16 kilometers  southwest of Perm. It is a dual-use military and civilian airport.

The Lashi Catholic Church, located in Lashi Village, Huangtang Town, Zijin County, Heyuan City, Guangdong Province, China, is a Catholic church dedicated to the Blessed Mother of the Forward Faith. Built in 1916, it was originally a wooden structure, but was damaged and neglected during the Cultural Revolution. It was rebuilt in 2010 and reopened on May 24, 2011, the day of the Patron Saint's Feast.

The Plato Decorative Art Museum, also known as the Italian Pavilion, is a foreigner's pavilion located in Yamamoto-dori, Kitano-cho, Chuo-ku, Kobe, Hyogo Prefecture, Japan. input: The Kurozweki Castle is a castle ruin located in the Holy Cross Province in southern Poland. This castle was originally built by a Polish nobleman. In 1655, the castle was partially destroyed by the Swedes, and then it became a ruin in the Russian invasion in 1770.

The Big Okhta Bridge, located on the Neva River in St. Petersburg, Russia, is a large bridge. Before 1917, the bridge was named Peter the Great Bridge. The bridge is 334 meters long and 23 meters wide.

Goose Market Square is a triangular city public square in Hamburg, Germany, located in the New Town of Hamburg. It is connected to the Virgin Dam in the east, Dammtorstraße and Valentinskamp in the northwest, and ABC-Straße in the south.

Laolongtou Reservoir, a small reservoir located in Chengshan Village and Sandao River in Dengta Town, Xi'an District, Liaoyuan City, Jilin Province, China, controls a catchment area of 47.43 square kilometers and has a total storage capacity of 9.64 million cubic meters. input: Falkland Palace, located in Falkland, Scotland, was once the palace of the Scottish king. Now, Falkland Palace is managed by the National Trust for Scotland. Before the construction of Falkland Palace, there was a hunting lodge here.

Vasabron (The Vasa Bridge) is a bridge in Stockholm, the capital of Sweden, connecting Norrmalm and Stockholm's Old Town. The bridge is named after the Swedish King Gustav Vasa. The construction of the Vasa Bridge began in 1872 and was completed six years later.

input: The Shahuang Weihe Bridge is a highway bridge located in Shahuang Village, Weinan City, Shaanxi Province, People's Republic of China. It is part of the National Highway G108. The bridge is 2294 meters long and construction began on October 31, 1991. It was completed in June 1994 and was the longest bridge in Shaanxi Province at the time of its completion. The Shahuang Weihe Bridge is the second bridge to span the Weihe River in Weinan City after the Shangzhangdu Weihe Bridge.

Xiangyang Tomb Group, located in Xiangyang Village, Yayuan Town, Erdaojiang District, Tonghua City, Jilin Province, China, is a provincial-level cultural relics protection unit. The type is ancient tombs, and the announcement time is May 31, 2007. This cultural relics protection unit is managed by the Office of the Cultural Relics Management Committee of Tonghua City. The historical period of the Xiangyang Tomb Group is the late Goguryeo period.
Sperlinga Castle  is a castle in Milan, Italy.

Sanxia Square is located in the downtown of Shapingba District, Chongqing, China, in the shape of a cross. It started construction in 1997 and is divided into four parts: Green Art Square, Commercial Culture Street, Celebrity Sculpture Garden, and Sanxia Landscape.

Cou Ijin-kan is a foreign-style building located in Ikuta District, Kobe City, Hyogo Prefecture, Japan. It is also part of the traditional architecture preserved in the Kitano/Yamamoto area. Since 2012, Yoshimi Kisen has been the tenant of this building and uses it as a guest house.
Castello Doria, also known as Castello di Vernazza, is a defensive building in Vernazza, Cinque Terre region, La Spezia province, located on a cliff seventy meters above the sea.

The Chakovec Castle is a medieval castle in the northern Croatian city of Chakovec. The castle is located in the Jelenski Park, not far from the city center square. On November 19, 2007, the Chakovec Castle was listed as a registered cultural protection building in Croatia.

The New Orthodox Synagogue is a synagogue in the Slovak city of Košice. The designer of this synagogue is the architect Ľudovít Oelschläger, and the exterior is neoclassical architecture. There is a Holocaust monument inside the synagogue.
The Church of San Francisco de Sales  is a church in Madrid, Spain, named after Saint Francis de Sales. It was listed as a Spanish cultural property in 1996.

input: The Wat Si Sawai is located in the Sukhothai Historical Park, a temple in Sukhothai Province, Thailand. The three standing pagodas are the landmarks of Wat Si Sawai, which are said to originate from the primitive religion's worship of the reproductive organs.

The National Sports Training Center  is the training base for the national sports team of the Republic of China . It is an administrative corporation under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Education. When it was put into use in 1976, it was called the "Zuoying Sports Training Center" .

Barclay Memorial Park, also known as Barclay Park, is Park No. 18, named in memory of the British pastor Barclay. It is located in Chongming Village, East District, Tainan City, and the Tainan Cultural Center is across the park.
Choto Sonar Mosque  is an ancient mosque located in Nawabganj district, Bangladesh.

Yekaterina Park is a park in Tsar Village, Russia, located 25 kilometers southeast of St. Petersburg. Yekaterina Park is named after the Yekaterina Palace, and the park is divided into a garden and an English garden.

Okayama Temple is a Tendai Buddhist temple located in the North District of Okayama City, Okayama Prefecture. The mountain is called Kinko Mountain, with Amitabha Tathagata, Thousand-Hand Guanyin, and Shakyamuni Tathagata as the main deities. Before the Middle Ages, it was in the Okayama Castle .

The Brandenburg Gate is one of the seven existing city gates in the Russian city of Kaliningrad, and it is the only city gate that is still in use in Kaliningrad. The Brandenburg Gate was built in the mid-19th century.

Changmen Battery (called Fort Blanc, meaning White Castle, by the French fleet during the Sino-French War), also known as Dian Guang Mountain Battery, is located on Dian Guang Mountain in Changmen Village, Guantou Town, Lianjiang County, Fujian Province. This place is on the north bank of the Minjiang River estuary, flanked by Jinpai Mountain on the south bank, guarding the narrowest part of the Minjiang River estuary. It is currently the oldest and largest existing battery in China, built during the Chongzhen period of the Ming Dynasty.

input: The Qing Shui Pu Bridge is a bridge over the Yong River in Ningbo City, Zhejiang Province, China. It carries the Ningbo Ring Expressway and is a joint tower split beam double tower four cable-stayed bridge. The main tower of the bridge is 141.5 meters high, the main span is 468 meters, and the width is 56.7 meters. It has eight lanes in both directions. Construction began on November 8, 2007, the main bridge was completed on December 15, 2010, and it was opened to traffic on December 28, 2011. At the time of its completion, it was the largest joint tower split beam cable-stayed bridge in the world.

input: The Woodland Cemetery is a cemetery in the southern part of Stockholm, the capital of Sweden. Its design style reflects the development from romantic nationalism to pragmatism.

The Golden Roof  is a landmark in Innsbruck, Austria, built by Holy Roman Emperor Maximilian I in 1500, decorated with 2657 gilded copper tiles. The reliefs on the balcony depict coats of arms, symbols, and other characters from his life.

Houge Station is located in Ganjingzi District, Dalian City, Liaoning Province. It is a station of Dalian Metro Line 2 and was put into operation on September 30, 2022, with the opening of the second phase of Line 2.

The Column of the Virgin Mary in Olomouc is a Baroque monument located in the Czech Republic's Olomouc, situated on the Lower Square of Olomouc. It was built for the grand Catholic thanksgiving ceremony held to appease the Black Death that attacked Moravia (now the Czech Republic) from 1714 to 1716.

input: Gorlitzer Park is a park in Berlin, the capital of Germany, located in Kreuzberg. The northwest corner of the park is Gorlitzer Station. The park was established in the 1980s, and before that, it was a train station. It is also a hotspot for buying marijuana.

The Miyagi Prefecture Art Museum is a Miyagi Prefecture public art museum located in Kawauchi Motozukura, Aoba Ward, Sendai City, Miyagi Prefecture, Japan. The designer of the main museum is Kunio Maekawa. The annex on the west side of the main museum is the Sato Tadayoshi Memorial Museum, which displays the works of Sato Tadayoshi. The main museum opened in 1981, and the Sato Tadayoshi Memorial Museum opened in 1990.

The Ishigaki Agricultural Association Rice Mill Granary, located in Wan'an Village, Ishigaki District, Taichung City, Taiwan, was specially equipped with earthquake resistance for the 1935 Hsinchu-Taichung earthquake. It was built in 1942 and survived the 1999 921 earthquake. It is now listed as a historical building.

input: The Takashima Observation Deck, also translated as the Korkeasaari Observation Deck, is located in the Helsinki Zoo on Takashima in Helsinki, Finland. It was built in 2002 and was designed and constructed by architect Veer Hara.

The Knin Fortress is a castle located in the city of Knin in the Dalmatian region of Croatia, situated on the highest mountain of the city, near the Krka River. This fortress is the second largest fortress building in Europe. Now it is a famous tourist attraction.

"Korean turbid wine", also known as "farmer's wine", translated into Chinese as "Magli", is a kind of Korean turbid rice wine fermented from rice and wheat, with an alcohol content of 6-8%, and a sweet taste. The Magli produced in the season of pear blossom bloom has the flavor of pear blossom, so it is called "pear blossom wine". Koreans generally drink Magli when eating mung bean cakes or onion cakes.

input: Blackbird, also known as X Jet, is an aircraft used for the virtual superhero team X-Men, sometimes also becoming the embodiment of X-Men, with Cyclops and Storm as the main pilots of the aircraft.

The Jiyang-class patrol ships have been equipped with some Wujin III combat systems, with a total of seven ships installed: Fengyang ship , Fenyang ship , Lanyang ship , Haiyang ship , Huaiyang ship , Ningyang ship , Yiyang ship .

A jet boat is a small boat propelled by a jet of water ejected from the stern. Unlike motorboats or motorboats that use external propellers in the water under or behind the boat, jet boats draw water from the bottom of the boat into the onboard water pump through the water inlet, and then discharge it through the nozzle at the stern. Modern jet boats were developed by New Zealand engineer Sir William Hamilton in the mid-1950s.

Titan stopped accepting computational tasks as of June 30, 2019, and officially retired on August 2 of the same year, and the computational tasks of Titan will be taken over by Summit in the future. The space left after the dismantling of Titan will be expanded and installed with the Frontier supercomputer, which also uses AMD processors. Frontier is expected to be completed in 2021 and will become the second-generation AI system after Summit.

rerlation.tail: the second-generation AI system after Summit

input: Kevin ZP98  is a pocket-sized semi-automatic pistol produced in the Czech Republic, which is sold in the United States by Magnum Research Company under the name of Mini Desert Eagle .
MP-472 "Vintuk" is a non-lethal handgun that fires 10x23mm T-caliber rubber bullets. The magazine capacity is 16 rounds, and the grip is made of blue plastic.

The Makassar-class dock landing ship is a type of dock landing ship, originally designed by Daewoo Shipbuilding of South Korea for the Indonesian Navy, named after the Indonesian city of Makassar, with the first ship commissioned in 2007. The Peruvian Navy calls this class of ship the Pisco-class, the Philippine Navy calls it the Tarlac-class, and the medical ship specially built by Indonesia is called the Dr. Wahidin Sudirohusodo-class.

Phenolic resin is a kind of synthetic plastic, a colorless or yellow-brown transparent solid, which is commonly used in electrical equipment and is also commonly known as Bakelite. It has excellent heat resistance, flame resistance, water resistance, and insulation, good acid resistance, poor alkali resistance, good mechanical and electrical properties, and is easy to cut. It is divided into thermosetting plastics and thermoplastics. By adding different components during synthesis, modified phenolic resins with different functions can be obtained, which have different excellent characteristics, such as alkali resistance, wear resistance, oil resistance, corrosion resistance, etc.

The Fokker F27 "Friendship" is a turboprop aircraft produced by the Dutch aircraft manufacturer Fokker. It is a small passenger aircraft of the 32-seat class, often used for regional or island routes with shorter distances.

rerlation.head: Fokker F27 "Friendship"
rerlation.tail: often used for regional or island routes with shorter distances

input: An electric fence, that is, a fence that is electrified, uses electric shocks to prevent people or animals from crossing a specific range. Its voltage can range from uncomfortable to lethal, depending on the desired goal. Most electric fences are used in farms or other animal management, and are also used in heavily guarded places, such as military facilities and prisons.

rerlation.head: Electric fence
rerlation.tail: prevent people or animals from crossing a specific range

input: Fire-control radar (English: fire-control radar, abbreviated: FCR) is a type of radar used to provide information to the fire control system to calculate the distance and angle of weapon launch.

Yapana shoes are traditional sandals in Myanmar, similar to flip-flops. Although it refers to the sandals worn by almost all Burmese people, it is mainly used to refer to the traditional Mandalay velvet slippers originated in Upper Myanmar. The literal meaning of Hnyat-phanat is "clip shoes", because the slippers are fixed by clamping with the thumb and the second toe.

The launch loop is a hypothetical non-rocket space launch structure. It works by using a maglev track mounted on an elevated loop 80 kilometers above the ground and 2000 kilometers long to launch payloads into a certain orbit. The entire track moves downward and in the opposite direction after ejecting the payload from the ground, returning to the original launch end, thus forming a circular loop. If it is enlarged to surround the Earth's circumference, it would be similar to an orbital ring.

rerlation.head: The launch loop
rerlation.tail: launch payloads into a certain orbit

input: Playing Hearts requires a deck of 52 playing cards, which is the same as the layout of bridge. The order of card sizes from large to small is A, K, Q, J, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, and 2. And there is no Joker.

Starstreak is a British man-portable air-defense system, developed by the Shorts Missile Systems company based in Belfast. It is used to replace the Javelin anti-aircraft missile. The British army's equipment has been replaced by the Starlight anti-aircraft missile.

The Smith & Wesson Sigma is a series of semi-automatic pistols developed and produced by the American firearms company Smith & Wesson. It is the company's first attempt to use synthetic materials in firearm construction, and the grip is made of high-strength polymer materials. The Sigma can fire a variety of different pistol bullets. Its design and operation are similar to the Glock safe maneuvering pistol, which has led to some controversy and speculation about the patent legality of the gun.

rerlation.head: The Smith & Wesson Sigma
rerlation.tail: fire a variety of different pistol bullets

input: Mazda Flair is a light high-top travel car, which has been OEM produced by Suzuki Motor since October 2012 and labeled with Mazda's emblem. This car is developed based on Suzuki Wagon R and is only sold in the Japanese domestic market. This car is the successor of AZ-Wagon and is also in the same series as Flair Wagon.

Qingxin Oolong, also known as Zhongcha, Zhongzi, Ruanzhi Oolong, and Yu Cong, is one of the traditional tea tree varieties in Taiwan. The variety originated from Anxi, Fujian, China, and was bred in Taiwan. It can be used to make Taiwanese Oolong tea, Baozhong tea, or Oriental Beauty tea.

rerlation.head: Qingxin Oolong
rerlation.tail: make Taiwanese Oolong tea, Baozhong tea, or Oriental Beauty tea

input: The VW166 amphibious vehicle (German: Volkswagen Typ166Schwimmwagen) was widely used by the German army during World War II. The designer was the famous Ferdinand Porsche, and it was produced by Volkswagen.

A sports bra is a type of bra that can provide extra support for women's breasts during exercise. Unlike regular bras, this type of bra reduces the swing range of the chest during exercise, thereby reducing discomfort and the risk of chest ligament strain. Some sports bras are designed to be worn outside . In addition, sports bras can also be used by men.

rerlation.tail: provide extra support for women's breasts during exercise

input: Squirrel Mandarin Fish, also known as Squirrel Grouper or Pine Nut Grouper, is a dish of fried fish in tomato sauce originating from Suzhou, Jiangsu, China. Made with Mandarin fish as the main ingredient, it is deboned, carved, fried into a squirrel shape, and then topped with sweet and sour sauce. This dish has a fresh and sweet taste, a crispy and tender texture, which may affect those who prefer salty flavors.

input: The Triple Crown  was a three-tiered crown worn by past popes, composed of a bishop's crown and a three-sided king's crown, with two trailing ribbons. In ceremonies, the pope does not wear it, but places it on the altar. The pope only wears it during the coronation ceremony, when delivering the blessing "To the City and the World", making solemn declarations from the Holy See, and when making appearances and exits.

The Chestnut Moray, also known as the Chestnut Hookjaw Moray, is one of the species of the Moray Eel family in the suborder of Moray and the order of Eel. It is distributed in the Western Atlantic region, from the Bermuda Islands, southern Florida in the United States to the waters of Brazil. It inhabits at a depth of 1-20 meters and can grow up to 34 centimeters in length. It is a bottom-dwelling fish that lives in coral reef areas. It is carnivorous, but its habits are unknown.

It can reach a length of 39.4 cm, inhabits swamps and mangroves, can tolerate changes in salinity, is carnivorous, feeds on fish and invertebrates, and can be used as food fish, ornamental fish, and farmed fish.

input: The Latticed Fangblenny, also known as the Latticed Dragonet, is one of the species of the Dragonet family in the suborder of Perch and the order of Perch-like fish of the class of Ray-finned fish. It is distributed in the western Pacific region of India, including the Chagos Islands, Thailand, the Ryukyu Islands, the Philippines, New Guinea, and other sea areas. It inhabits depths of 8-85 meters and can reach a length of 40 centimeters. It lives in sandy and muddy sea areas near coral reefs and is carnivorous, feeding on fish and invertebrates. It can be used as a food fish.
Shiluzhu (scientific name: Phyllostachys arcana) is a species under the genus Phyllostachys of the family Poaceae.
Beilschmiedia glauca var.glaucoides, commonly known as Dingxu Qiongnan, is a variety under the genus Beilschmiedia of the Lauraceae family.

Aspergillus aureolatus, also known as 具黄曲霉 in Chinese, is a type of fungus belonging to the Aspergillus genus of the Ascomycota order and the Aspergillaceae family. It can grow on substrates such as cotton yarn, kerosene storage tanks, and air. This species is distributed in China, Yugoslavia, and other places.
Acer wuyuanense var.trichopodum, also known as the hairy-stemmed Wuyuan maple, is a variety under the genus Acer of the Aceraceae family.

The Pylospira Octopyle, commonly known as the shell bug, is an animal of the shell bug genus in the stone sun bug family. It is distributed in the North Pacific, including the East Sea and other sea areas.
The Luoyang peony is nationally renowned, and the Paeonia genus includes species such as peony, phoenix dan, and Chinese peony.
Leishan Rhododendron (scientific name: Rhododendron leishanicum) is a species under the genus Rhododendron of the Rhododendron family.

The Garnet Pitta (scientific name: Erythropitta granatina) is a species of the genus Erythropitta in the Pittidae family, distributed in Brunei, Myanmar, Singapore (extinct), Thailand, Indonesia, and Malaysia. The average weight of the Garnet Pitta is about 54.0 grams. Its habitats include subtropical or tropical swamp forests, subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests, and subtropical or tropical severely degraded former forests.

The Viosca's moray, also known as Viosca's naked chest moray, is one of the species of the Moray eel family in the suborder of Conger eel under the order of Anguilliformes in the class of Ray-finned fish. It is distributed in the Middle Eastern Pacific region, from the southern part of the Gulf of California to the waters of Peru, with a habitat depth of up to 10 meters and a body length of up to 43 centimeters. It is a benthic fish and carnivorous, but its living habits are unknown.

Maclura pomifera, also known as Chinese mulberry, Chinese fruit , Horse apple, Osage orange, bow wood, orange mulberry, is a plant of the orange mulberry genus in the mulberry family. Because the appearance of the fruit is like the shape of the brain, it is commonly known as monkey brain fruit.
The genus Vulgarogamasus belongs to the family of Parasitidae.
Lily is a Suri alpaca, and there are varieties of alpacas such as Suri alpaca and Huacaya alpaca.

Western gorillas can be divided into two subspecies, namely Western lowland gorillas (G.g.gorilla) and Cross River gorillas (G.g.diehli). Most Western gorillas belong to the Western lowland gorillas, with a population of about 94,000. The number of Cross River gorillas is less than 300.

The Narrow-bridged Musk Turtle (scientific name: Claudius angustatus), also known as the Hawk-billed Mud Turtle, Narrow-bridged Musk Turtle, and Narrow-bridged Egg Turtle, is the only species of the genus Claudius in the subfamily of Musk Turtles. It is native to the freshwaters of Mexico, Guatemala, and Belize, with a shell length of about 15 centimeters. It is carnivorous, mainly feeding on aquatic mollusks and also eating carrion.
Leucopoa sclerophylla, commonly known as the hard-leaved silver spike grass, is a plant species under the genus Leucopoa of the family Poaceae.

The Chestnut-tailed Desert Lark (scientific name: Ammomanes phoenicura) is a species of the Desert Lark genus in the Lark family, distributed in India, Nepal, and Pakistan. The conservation status of this species is rated as non-endangered. The average weight of the Chestnut-tailed Desert Lark is about 25.6 grams. Its habitats include subtropical or tropical (lowland) dry grasslands and subtropical or tropical (lowland) dry shrublands.
Yunnan Tofu Firewood (scientific name: Premna yunnanensis) is a species under the genus Tofu Firewood of the Verbenaceae family. Its species epithet yunnanensis means "of Yunnan".

The genus Oedipoda, also known as the band-winged grasshopper, is a model genus of the subfamily of band-winged grasshoppers in the family of sword-horned grasshoppers of the order Orthoptera, distributed in Europe, North Africa, Asia, and Oceania.

The Thayeria boehlkei, a species of the family Characidae in the suborder Characoidei of the order Perciformes in the class Actinopterygii, is distributed in the Tietê River and Paraná River basin in Brazil, South America. It can reach a length of 7.9 cm, inhabits the middle and bottom water layers, and its habits are unknown.

input: The Greenback Flounder is one of the species of the Rhombosoleidae family in the order Pleuronectiformes, suborder Pleuronectoidei, class Actinopterygii. It is distributed in the waters and brackish waters of Australia and New Zealand, with a habitat depth of up to 100 meters and a body length of up to 45 centimeters. It is a bottom-dwelling fish that lives in sandy seabed areas and estuaries. It is carnivorous, but its habits are unknown. It can be used as food fish and game fish.

The King Atherinomorus Regina (scientific name: Atherinomorus regina) is one of the species of the Atherinidae family, distributed in the waters of the Culion and Busuanga islands in the Western Pacific Philippines. It can grow up to 7 centimeters long, is a tropical fish, and lives in shallow coastal waters. Its habits are unknown.
The genus Fuscozetes (scientific name: Fuscozetes) is a genus of the family Acaridae.

The genus Gallus (scientific name: Gallus) is a genus of the Phasianidae family in the order Galliformes, which are larger birds. The male birds have rich and colorful feathers, distributed in India, Sri Lanka and Southeast Asia, including four species, among which the junglefowl is considered to be the likely ancestor of today's chickens.

Myxidium odontobutis, also known as the sand gudgeon myxosporean, is an animal of the Myxidium genus in the Myxidiidae family. In China, it is distributed in areas such as Zhejiang, leading a parasitic life, parasitizing in the bladder and hindgut of the sand gudgeon.

The Sharp-toothed Moray, also known as the Sharp-toothed Hook-nosed Moray, is one of the species of the Moray family under the order of Anguilliformes and the class of Actinopterygii. It is distributed in the Eastern Atlantic region, including the Azores, Madeira Islands, Canary Islands, Cape Verde Islands, Saint Helena, etc. It inhabits at a depth of 3-60 meters and can grow up to 120 centimeters in length. It is a bottom-dwelling fish that lives in gravel and rocky seabed areas. It is carnivorous, feeding on crustaceans and fish, and can be used as food.
Multilobed glandular fly grass (scientific name: Silene yetii var.herbilegorum) is a variant under the genus of fly grass in the Caryophyllaceae family.

The Mexican Tetra, a species of the family Characidae in the suborder Characoidei of the order Perciformes of the class Actinopterygii, is distributed in the freshwater areas of Belize and Mexico in Central America. It can reach a length of 9.7 cm, inhabits the middle and bottom water layers, and its habits are unknown.

Scarlet Waxy Cap (scientific name: Hygrocybe coccinea), also known as Scarlet Hood, Scarlet Waxcap, or Righteous Red Waxy Cap, is a brightly colored fungus of the Basidiomycota phylum, belonging to the genus Hygrocybe. This fungus is widely distributed in the northern hemisphere, east to China and Japan, west to the UK and the US, where traces of Scarlet Waxy Cap can be found. This bright red mushroom grows in late summer and autumn, with a cap diameter of 0.4–1 cm, and has a stem.

The Yellow-spotted moray (scientific name: Echidna xanthospilos), also known as Yellow-spotted snake moray, Yellow-spotted moray, Money eel, Potato eel, Tiger eel, is one of the species of the Moray eel family in the suborder of snake eels of the order of Anguilliformes of the class of ray-finned fishes, distributed in the waters of Indonesia and Papua New Guinea in the central and western Pacific, it is a benthic fish, carnivorous, with unknown habits.

The Fine-spotted Moray, also known as Fine-spotted Moray, Fine-spotted Double Plow Moray, Money Eel, Potato Eel, Tiger Eel, is one of the species of the Moray family under the order of Anguilliformes, suborder of Muraenoidei, class of Actinopterygii. It is distributed in the Indian Pacific region, from East Africa to the Galapagos Islands, north to the Ryukyu Islands, and south to the Australian waters. It inhabits at a depth of 5-100 meters and can grow up to 140 centimeters in length. It is a bottom-dwelling fish that lives in the intertidal zone with rocky substrates. It is carnivorous, feeding on crustaceans and fish. It can be used as a food fish, and there are reports of ciguatera poisoning.

The Borneo Pitcher Plant is a vine plant that can grow up to 2.5 meters, and at most up to 10 meters. The stem can branch, often clinging to the surrounding vegetation, but can also grow creeping on the ground. The stem is cylindrical or slightly angular, with a diameter of up to 5 millimeters, and the internode distance can reach 2 centimeters. No subspecies of the Borneo Pitcher Plant have been found yet.

It is a subtropical marine fish, distributed in the southwestern Pacific Ocean in New Zealand; the eastern Pacific Ocean from the Gulf of California in Mexico to the waters of Peru, inhabiting depths of 1-121 meters. It can reach a length of 15.7 centimeters, dwelling in soft bottom waters, but its habits are unknown. It can be used as a food fish.

input: The Cocos Island flathead is one of the species of the family Platycephalidae, a tropical marine fish, distributed in the western Indian Pacific region, from Mozambique to Fiji, north to Japan, and south to the waters of Queensland, Australia. It inhabits depths of 1-30 meters and can reach a length of 12 centimeters. It inhabits clear water, sandy lagoons, and coral reef areas, but its habits are unknown.

Petersius conserialis, also known as Peter's characin, is a species of fish in the order Characiformes, suborder Characoidei, and family Alestidae. They are the only species in the genus Petersius, and are endemic to Tanzania. They can reach a length of 14.5 centimeters and inhabit the middle layer of river bottoms. Their habits are unknown.

The Hardhead Mojarra (scientific name: Atherinomorus stipes) is one of the species of the Mojarra family, distributed in the western Atlantic Bahamas, the Yucatan Peninsula of Mexico to the waters of Brazil, with a body length of up to 10 cm. It is a tropical fish, living in coastal sandy and coral reef shallow waters, feeding on plankton, and its habits are unknown.
The Red-eared Parrotfinch (scientific name: Erythrura coloria) is a type of Munia, endemic to the island of Mindanao in the Philippines.

Asteridiella melastomatacearum, also known as Wild Peony Small Light Shell, is a type of fungus belonging to the genus of Small Light Shell in the family of Small Coal Shell under the order of Small Coal Shell. It parasitizes on plants of the Wild Peony family. This species is distributed in China, Brazil, Paraguay, Panama, Uganda, Jamaica, Ecuador, Cuba, Guyana, Argentina, Venezuela, Puerto Rico, Honduras, the United States, Bolivia, the Philippines, Sierra Leone, and other places.

The Long-arm Left Flounder is one of the species of the Pleuronectidae family, a deep-sea fish, distributed in the Western Indian Ocean Kenya, Mozambique, South African waters, living at a depth of 180-310 meters, can reach a length of 19 centimeters, inhabits the bottom waters, feeds on benthic organisms, and its habits are unknown.
Black Madder (scientific name: Rubia mandersii) is a plant species under the genus Rubia of the family Rubiaceae.
Thin-leaved Primrose (scientific name: Primula membranifolia) is a species under the genus Primula of the Primulaceae family.
Strophioblachia fimbricalyx, commonly known as Strophioblachia, is a species of plant in the genus Strophioblachia of the Euphorbiaceae family.
Juncellus limosus, commonly known as marsh cyperus, is a species under the genus of Cyperus in the Cyperaceae family.
Ahai is a dromedary camel, and there are 2 types of camels: dromedary camels and Bactrian camels.
The genus Parabelbella (scientific name: Parabelbella) is a genus of the family of pearl mites.
Synechocystis (scientific name: Synechocystis) is a genus of the family Chroococcaceae.
Pinguicula villosa, commonly known as the northern butterwort, is a species under the genus Pinguicula of the family Lentibulariaceae.
The Blanford's Lark (scientific name: Calandrella blanfordi) is a species of the genus Short-toed Lark in the family Lark, distributed in Somalia, Saudi Arabia, Ethiopia, Yemen, Eritrea, and Oman.
The Black-footed Aoria nigripes, a species under the genus of Aoria, belongs to the family of Chrysomelidae. The specific epithet "nigripes" means "black-footed".

Ze Sheng Huan, also known as Ze Sheng Moray, is one of the species of the Moray family in the suborder Huan of the order Anguilliformes of the class Actinopterygii. It is distributed in the Eastern Atlantic region, from the eastern part of the British Isles to the waters of Senegal, including the Mediterranean Sea. It inhabits at a depth of 15-50 meters and can reach a length of 150 centimeters. It is a benthic fish, living in reef areas and coral reefs. It is carnivorous, feeding at night, with fish, crustaceans, and squid as its main food sources. It can be used as food fish and ornamental fish.

input: The Brown-striped Window-winged Leafhopper (scientific name: Mileewa fusciovittata) is a species under the genus of Window-winged Leafhoppers in the family of Leafhoppers.
Variegated peach is a kind of peach plant in Beijing Botanical Garden. The Prunus genus includes species such as black cherry, Chinese apricot, and peach.

Bhutan Campion (Scientific name: Silene indica var.bhutanica) is a variety under the genus Campion of the family Caryophyllaceae. The species epithet "indica" means "of India". The variety epithet "bhutanica" means "of Bhutan".

Lele is a spotted deer, which belongs to a smaller size. There are 4 classifications: Spotted deer (Axis axis), Calamian deer (Axis calamianensis), Bawean deer (Axis kuhlii), and Hog deer (Axis porcinus).
White-backed Yushania (scientific name: Yushania glauca) is a species under the genus Yushania of the family Poaceae.

The Hejiang Myxidium (scientific name: Myxidium hokiangensis) is an animal of the Myxidium genus in the Myxidium family. In China, it is distributed in Sichuan and other places, living a parasitic life, parasitizing in the gallbladder of yellow-headed fish and Chinese stickleback.
Kobresia seticulmis, commonly known as the stiff sedge, is a species under the genus Kobresia of the family Cyperaceae.
Yunnan Tarenna (scientific name: Tarenna yunnanensis) is a species under the genus Tarenna of the Rubiaceae family. Its species epithet yunnanensis means "of Yunnan".

Myxidium nasali, also known as the nasal myxidium, is an animal of the Myxidium genus in the Myxidium family. In China, it is distributed in places like Sichuan and lives a parasitic life, parasitizing in the nasal cavity of perch.

Utricularia foliosa, also known as leafy bladderwort, is a large, floating, carnivorous plant of the bladderwort genus, suspected to be perennial. The species epithet "foliosa" comes from the Latin "folium", meaning "leaf". Leafy bladderwort is distributed in Africa, North America, and South America.
The genus Dynomene (Dynomene) is a branch of the subfamily of Dynomenidae, which belongs to the superfamily of sponge crabs, and was discovered in 1823. The type genus is: D.hispida.
Narrow-leaved red light tree (scientific name: Knema cinerea) is a species under the genus of red light tree in the Myristicaceae family.

The Ali Pitcher Plant, also known as the Leopard Pitcher-Plant (Leopard Pitcher-Plant), is a natural hybrid species derived from the hybridization of the Leopard Spotted Pitcher Plant (N. burbidgeae) and the Malay King Pitcher Plant (N. rajah), and is only found in Mount Kinabalu in Sabah, Borneo. It is named after the former chairman of the Sabah Parks Trust, Ramli Ali. Both of its parents grow at an altitude of 1930 to 1950 meters on Pig Mountain.

The Short-toed Lark (scientific name: Calandrella somalica) is a species of the lark family, genus Short-toed Lark. It is a migratory bird that hunts and distributes in Somalia, Kenya, Tanzania, and Ethiopia. The global activity range is about 298,000 square kilometers. The conservation status of this species has been rated as non-endangered. The habitat of the Short-toed Lark is subtropical or tropical (lowland) dry grassland.
Mimi is a cute American Shorthair cat, and the cat breeds include shorthair cats, longhair cats, tabby cats, Persian cats, etc.
Spiradiclis baishaiensis, commonly known as Baise snail order grass, is a species under the genus of snail order grass in the Rubiaceae family.

Mulberry orange is native to the central United States, including a narrow strip in the southwest of Arkansas, southeast of Oklahoma, east of Texas, and northwest corner of Louisiana. It has been introduced and cultivated in places like Dalian, Liaoning and Qinhuangdao, Hebei in China.

Hymenogaster albus, also known as White Roundhead Umbrella, is a type of basidiomycete belonging to the genus Hymenogaster of the family Hymenogastraceae in the order Agaricales. The species epithet "albus" means "white". input: The Rosy Goatfish is one of the species of the family Mullidae, under the suborder Pleuronectiformes and the order Perciformes. It resides in soft-bottomed lagoons and bays, feeding on crustaceans, polychaetes, and mollusks. Its habits are unknown and it can be used as a food fish.
Eulophia bracteosa, commonly known as Long Bract Eulophia, is a species of plant under the genus Eulophia of the Orchidaceae family.

The Pin-tailed Parrotfinch (scientific name: Erythrura hyperythra) is a common munia found in Indonesia, Malaysia, and the Philippines. Its global activity range is approximately 1,000,000 to 10,000,000 square kilometers. The Pin-tailed Parrotfinch is distributed in subtropical and tropical mountainous wet forests. Longshan Rhododendron (scientific name: Rhododendron chunii) is one or two species under the genus Rhododendron of the Rhododendron family.

It is distributed in the Western Atlantic region, from southern Florida in the United States to Brazil, and in the Eastern Atlantic region, including the Madeira Islands, Azores, Cape Verde Islands, Canary Islands, etc. It can inhabit depths of up to 145 meters and can grow up to 122 centimeters in length. input: The High-bodied Purple Fish, also known as the High-bodied Princess Bream, is one of the species of the family Pomacentridae, suborder Percoidei, order Perciformes, class Actinopterygii. It is distributed in the Western Atlantic region, from Canada to the waters of Santa Catarina, Brazil, with a habitat depth of 24-370 meters. This fish has large eyes, a pinkish-red back, pink sides, and a silver-white belly. Except for the yellow tail and dorsal fins, all other fins are slightly transparent pink. It has 10 dorsal fin spines, 10-11 dorsal fin soft rays, 3 anal fin spines, and 7-8 anal fin soft rays. It can reach a length of 56 centimeters, is carnivorous, and feeds on fish. It can be used as a food fish.
The genus Coturnix, also known as Quail, is a genus of the Phasianidae family, and its members are mainly small brown birds.

The Red-faced Crimson-wing (scientific name: Cryptospiza reichenovii) is a common finch in Africa. Its global distribution range is about 390,000 square kilometers. West Mountain Silver Spike Grass (Scientific name: Leucopoa olgae) is a plant species under the Silver Spike Grass genus of the Poaceae family.

The Light Moray, also known as the Light Moray Eel, is one of the species of the Moray Eel family in the suborder of Moray under the order of Anguilliformes in the class of Ray-finned fish. It is distributed in the Eastern Pacific region, from Mexico to the waters of Peru, inhabiting depths of 18-60 meters. It can reach a length of 120 centimeters, is a bottom-dwelling fish, living in rocky seabed areas, usually hiding in rock crevices and caves. It is carnivorous, its habits are unknown, and it can be used as a food fish.
Cephalanthera, also known as Jinlan genus, is a branch of the Orchidaceae family. There are about 15 species in the Cephalanthera genus, which are native to Europe, Asia, and North America.

Eurotium echinulatum, also known as the spore sac fungus, is a type of fungus belonging to the genus of sac fungi in the family of Ascomycetes. It can grow on substrates such as soil, cow dung, and figs. This species is distributed in China, the United States, the Netherlands, Norway, Spain, the United Kingdom, and the former Yugoslavia. The spore sac fungus is the sexual type of Aspergillus brunneus.
Tabu (scientific name: Sabina chinensis cv.Pyramidalis) is a variety/cultivation type under the genus Sabina of the cypress family.
Teyleria koordersii, commonly known as Qiong bean, is a species under the genus of Qiong bean in the Fabaceae family.

The Spectacled owl (scientific name: Pulsatrix perspicillata), a nocturnal bird of prey in the tropical American forest area of the order Strigiformes and family Strigidae. The young birds are white with a black face disk. The adult bird is about 50 centimeters long; the upper body is brown, the lower body is lighter, and the chest is also brown. The face is brown with white eyebrows.

The Sand smelt (scientific name: Atherina presbyter) is one of the species of the Atherinidae family, distributed in the eastern Atlantic from the UK to the Canary Islands. Caragana rosea, also known as Red Flower Caragana, is a plant species belonging to the genus Caragana of the Fabaceae family.
Big Mouse Ear (scientific name: Berchemia hirtella var.glabrescens) is a variant under the genus Berchemia of the Rhamnaceae family.

The genus Callinectes, also known as the beautiful green crab, is a genus of the family Portunidae, and the blue crab belongs to this genus. The species under it have a pair of flat walking legs, a flat and wide carapace, and teeth at the front end of the carapace, near the eyes, and at the rear end. The largest tooth is located between the eyes. The back of the beautiful green crab genus is generally olive green or blue, the bottom is white, and there are blue or red places on the thin claws. Shuipu Township is a township-level administrative unit under Xiangcheng County, Garze Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province, People's Republic of China.

Cachibio is a town in Colombia, located in the southwest of the country, under the jurisdiction of Cauca Province, 29 kilometers away from the capital Popayan. It was founded on October 16, 1560, with an area of 747 square kilometers, an altitude of 1,520 meters, and a population of 34,818 in 2005.

The Chongoni Rock Art Area, located in the central highlands of Malawi, is a World Heritage Site in Malawi. The Chongoni Rock Art Area covers an area of 126.4 square kilometers and was listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List in 2006. The rock paintings in the art area reflect the local culture.

Ma Lake is a plateau freshwater lake in China, located 47 kilometers northeast of Leibo County, Sichuan Province, People's Republic of China. It is a provincial scenic spot and geological park in Sichuan Province. The Menghuo Temple in the lake area is also a cultural relic protection unit in Sichuan Province. In June 1982, the Nanjing Institute of Geography of the Chinese Academy of Sciences measured the maximum depth of Ma Lake to be 134 meters using ultrasonic waves. The vegetation in the lake area is lush and there are extensive primitive forests.

Guxiang Town is a town-level administrative unit under Chaoan County, Chaozhou City, Guangdong Province, People's Republic of China. The total area of the town is 62 square kilometers, with 18 village committees and 1 neighborhood committee. The population is 64,000 people, and the temporary population is more than 10,000 people.

Andhra Pradesh is one of the 29 states in India. In the national rectification movement in 1956, the existing Andhra Pradesh and the Telugu-speaking region of Hyderabad State were merged into Andhra Pradesh. On June 2, 2014, Andhra Pradesh was divided into the new Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.

The Shapotou Tourist Area in Zhongwei City is located 16 kilometers west of the Shapotou District of Zhongwei City in the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region of the People's Republic of China, at the southeast edge of the Tengger Desert, and is one of the first batch of national 5A-level tourist areas in China.

Later Zhao  was a regime established by the Jie tribe leader Shi Le during the Sixteen Kingdoms period. Because Shi Le's ruled area was the former land of the Zhao State during the Warring States period, Liu Yao therefore conferred him as the King of Zhao, and the country was named after this. To distinguish it from the earlier established Former Zhao, it is historically referred to as "Later Zhao", and also known as "Shi Zhao" due to the royal family's surname Shi. It is also called Northern Zhao.

input: Novoolekminsk is a town-level settlement in the Agaburiat District of the Trans-Baikal Territory, Russia, belonging to the Akinskoye District, located in the eastern part of the district, southeast of the district administrative center Akinskoye and southeast of the territorial capital Chita. The population of this place was 2,747 in 2021; 3,110 in 2010; 2,859 in 2002; and 5,298 in 1989.
Sutton-in-Ashfield is a town in the Ashfield district of Nottinghamshire, England, with a population of about 45,800. It is located 4 miles west of Mansfield, close to the border of Derbyshire.

Langenfeld is a city in the Düsseldorf administrative district of North Rhine-Westphalia in western Germany, located between Düsseldorf and Cologne, with a population of 59,056 in 2009. The city has convenient transportation, and the nearby area has Cologne/Bonn Airport.

input: North Waziristan, a special area of the Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa province in Pakistan, has a total area of 11,585 square kilometers and a total population of 361,246 . In 2018, it was incorporated into the provinces of Pakistan along with the Federally Administered Tribal Areas. The terrain is rugged and mountainous, with severe winters and hot summers.

Xiaomenyu is one of the Penghu Islands, belonging to Xiaomen Village, Xiyu Township, Penghu County. Because it is located next to the Humen Channel, it is known as the Pearl of Humen. Its location is to the north of Xiyu, separated from Xiyu by a channel about 20 meters wide. The area is about 0.5 square kilometers , and the highest point is on the northwest side of the island, 23 meters high.

Caiyi Street is located in Guangling District, Yangzhou City, Jiangsu Province. It extends from Dadongmen Bridge in the west to Dongguan Street in the east. It is a bustling street in the city that largely maintains its traditional layout, with many shops along the street originally engaged in the silk industry. Currently, there are many cultural relics protection units in Yangzhou City along the street, such as Dadongmen Bridge, Zhang's Residence , Yang Zimu's former residence , Jingde Guild Hall, etc. Zhucao Poetry Forest  is located in Mituo Lane.

Horni Brod is a town in the South Bohemian Region of the Czech Republic. It has a population of about 2600, and it is the southernmost city of the Czech Republic. The Horni Brod Monastery here is a very important historical milestone.

Mount Kombu is a third-stage dormant volcano in Abuta District, Hokkaido, Japan, spanning across the towns of Shinsetsu Valley and Toyoura, located about 69 kilometers southwest of Sapporo. In 2014, after a re-measurement by the Japan Geographical Survey Institute, its altitude was determined to be 1044.9 meters, making it one of the hundred famous mountains in Hokkaido.

The Division of Calwell, an electorate for the lower house of the Parliament of Victoria, Australia, is located in the northern suburbs of Melbourne, the capital of the state. It covers an area of 504 square kilometers. The electorate was established in 1984 and was named in honor of Arthur Calwell, the Minister for Immigration and leader of the Labor Party. This area is a safe seat for the Labor Party. Since 2001, the local representative has been Maria Vamvakinou.

Port-Cartier is a town in the North Shore region of Quebec, Canada. It is located on the north shore of the Saint Lawrence River, 63 kilometers southwest of Sept-Îles. It has an area of 1073 square kilometers and a population of 6,412 (as of 2001).
Quetta District, a district of Balochistan Province in Pakistan. The total area is 4057 square kilometers, and the total population is 1,140,000 . The administrative center is located in Quetta City.

Anyang City is located in the northernmost part of Henan Province, at the junction of Shanxi, Hebei and Henan provinces, known as the "Important Town of Northern Henan" and "Thoroughfare of Three Provinces". It is an important hub of transportation in north and south China and one of the five regional logistics hubs in the Central Plains Economic Zone.
Finley is a census-designated place in Benton County, Washington, United States. The population was 6,012 at the 2010 United States Census. This city is located southwest of Kennewick.

Dazhai Town is a town under the jurisdiction of Xiyang County, Jinzhong City, Shanxi Province, People's Republic of China. Dazhai Village in the study of agriculture belongs to Dazhai Town. In 2019, it was rated as one of the top 100 cultural towns in China.
Malan Town is a township-level administrative unit under Gujiao City, Taiyuan City, Shanxi Province, People's Republic of China.
Shinano Province, one of the ancient provinces of Japan, belonged to Tōsandō, also known as Shinshū. The territory of Shinano Province is approximately the present Nagano Prefecture.
Shimotsuke Province, one of the ancient provinces of Japan, belonged to Tōsandō, also known as Yashū. The territory of Shimotsuke Province is approximately the current Tochigi Prefecture.

Ba Wei County is bordered by Shanxi City Society to the east, Shi Shi County to the southeast, Yongxiang County of Yongfu Province to the northeast, San Nong County and Qing Shui County of Fushou Province to the west, He Ping City of He Ping Province to the south, and Yue Chi City and Lin Tao County of Fushou Province to the north.

input: The Niangmiao Mountain Site, located in Niangmiao Mountain Village, Jingtai Town, Yitong County, Jilin Province, China, is a provincial-level cultural relic protection unit. The type is an ancient site, and the announcement time is May 31, 2007. This cultural relic protection unit is managed by the Yitong County Cultural Management Office. The historical era of the Niangmiao Mountain Site is the Bronze Age.

Concepción Volcano is an active volcano in Nicaragua, Central America, located in the northwest of Ometepe Island in Lake Nicaragua. The volcano has erupted more than 25 times since 1883, with the most recent eruption on December 11, 2009. There is a volcanic vent on the north side of the crater.

Suzhou High-speed Rail New City is a new city located near Suzhou North Station of Beijing-Shanghai High-speed Railway in Xiangcheng District, Suzhou City, Jiangsu Province, China. It is one of the "four cities" in Suzhou's "one core, four cities" plan. The planned area of the core area of Suzhou High-speed Rail New City is 28.52 square kilometers, of which the start-up area is 4.7 square kilometers. Suzhou High-speed Rail New City plans to be built into an important transportation hub and modern service industry cluster in Suzhou.

input: Lacey, located in Thurston County, Washington, United States, is a suburb of Olympia. The population was 42,393 at the 2010 United States Census.

Wendkai Shen Island is an island in the Atlantic Ocean, located 4.5 kilometers northeast of Kandelmers Island, part of the Kandelmers Islands, 3 kilometers long, 2 kilometers wide, with an area of 5 square kilometers and an altitude of 430 meters. The island was discovered by British navigators in 1775 and is uninhabited.

Tolu is a town in Colombia, located on the northern Caribbean coast of the country, under the jurisdiction of Sucre Province. It was founded on July 25, 1535, with an area of 500 square kilometers and an altitude of 2 meters. The main economic activities are fishing and tourism, with a population of 27,957 in 2005.
The Niger Delta, also known as the Macina region, is a large area of lakes and floodplains in the semi-arid Sahel region in central Mali, south of the Sahara Desert.

The site of Qianchengzi, located in Qianchengzi Village, Xinxing Township, Yitong County, Jilin Province, China, is a provincial-level cultural relic protection unit. The type is an ancient city site, and the announcement time is May 31, 2007. This cultural relic protection unit is managed by the Yitong County Cultural Management Office. The historical era of the Qianchengzi site is the Jin Dynasty.

Wakayama Prefecture is located in the western part of the Kii Peninsula on Honshu Island, Japan, and belongs to the Kinki region. The capital is Wakayama City. Due to the migration of many people to Osaka Prefecture, Wakayama Prefecture is also the only prefecture in the Kinki region where the population has decreased in nearly forty years.

Aguazul is a town in Colombia, located in the eastern part of the country, under the jurisdiction of the Casanare Province. It is about 27 kilometers away from the provincial capital Yopal, with an area of 1,330 square kilometers, an altitude of 290 meters, and a population of 27,443 in 2005.

The Willis Islands  are a group of islands in the South Atlantic, located 3.2 kilometers west of Bird Island, composed of 10 islands. The islands were discovered by British explorer James Cook in 1775, and no one lives on the island.

The Frontier Region Peshawar, is a frontier region of the Federally Administered Tribal Areas of Pakistan. This frontier region is named after the adjacent Peshawar County. The Frontier Region Peshawar is bordered by Peshawar County to the north, Nowshera County to the east, and Kohat County to the south.

Chang'an Township includes the following administrative territories: Chang'an Village, Dongta Village, Ketou Village, Guojia Liang Village, Shuiyi Village, Longzhuang Gou Village, Xiaolou Feng Village, Mulian Po Village, Nantou Village, Qu Ping Village, Shui Ge Duo Village, Zhangshan Ge Duo Village, Duan Duan Ge Duo Village, Ma Jia Kou Village, Xizhuang Tou Village, and Xin Zhuang Village.

Omi Province, one of the ancient administrative divisions of Japan, belonged to the Tōsandō, also known as Gōshū. The territory of Omi Province is approximately the current Shiga Prefecture, and it contains Lake Biwa, the largest lake in Japan.

Daykundi Province is one of the 34 provinces of Afghanistan, located in the central part of Afghanistan, with a population of approximately 723,980, mainly Hazaras. Daykundi Province belongs to the region where Hazaras are the majority, also known as Hazarajat, with Nili as the provincial capital. It borders Bamyan Province to the northeast, Ghazni Province to the southeast, Uruzgan Province to the south, Helmand Province to the southwest, and Ghor Province to the northwest.

Glasgow South, a constituency of the British Parliament, is located south of the city center of Glasgow, Scotland. The constituency was established in 2005. Since its establishment, the district councilor has been Tom Harris of the Labour Party. In the 2010 general election, he was re-elected with 51.7% of the votes. Since 2015, it has been elected by the Scottish National Party.

Awa Province, one of the ancient provinces of Japan, belonged to the Tokaido, also known as Fuso and Nanzong. The territory of Awa Province is approximately the southern part of present-day Chiba Prefecture.

The Shangri-La is located in Yangshuo, Guangxi Province, People's Republic of China, in the middle section of the Guiyang Highway from Guilin to Yangshuo. It is a national 4A-level tourist area that combines natural landscapes and cultural charm, and is a tourist area recommended by the World Tourism Organization.

Eidskog is a municipality in Norway, located in the Inland County, with the administrative center in Skotterud village. The municipality covers an area of 641 square kilometers, with a population of 6,431 people (as of 2004), and a population density of 11 people per square kilometer.

Dongxin County is a county in the southeast of Chijiang Road, Democratic People's Republic of Korea, adjacent to Ping'annan Road in the southeast. It is located between Diyuling Mountain Range and Miaoxiang Mountain Range, upstream of Qingchuan River. The highest point is Xiongyushuishan with an altitude of 2,019 meters. The area is 1,205 square kilometers, and the population in 2008 was 47,460. It is divided into 1 town and 14 villages.

Bakewell is a market town and civil parish in Derbyshire, England, known for Bakewell pudding. According to the 2011 UK census, it has a population of 3,949. It is estimated to have a population of 3,695 in 2019.

Culemborg (also spelled as Kuilenburg or Kuylenburgh) is a city and municipality in the Gelderland province of the Netherlands, located south of the Lek River. The city was granted city rights in 1315.

Oita Prefecture is located in the northeastern part of Kyushu, Japan. The prefectural office is located in Oita City. The number of hot springs and the amount of spring water are both the first in Japan. Beppu Hot Spring facing Beppu Bay and Yufuin Hot Spring located in the center of Oita Prefecture have a fairly high reputation in Japan. Oita Prefecture also uses "Japan's No.1 Hot Spring Prefecture Oita" as a tourism slogan.

To the north and east, Mainz is separated from the capital of Hesse, Wiesbaden, by the Rhine River. To the southeast, it is separated from the Gross-Gerau county of Hesse by the Rhine River. To the south and west, Mainz is surrounded by the Mainz-Bingen county.

Jiangla, also translated as Jingla and Jiangla, is a Dai village in the eastern border of Shan State, Myanmar, located on the west bank of the Mekong River at the large bay, which is a riverside plain. Jiangla is surrounded by the Mekong River on the north, east, and south, and the west is the only land opening connected to Myanmar. In 1957, the headquarters of the Yunnan People's Anti-Communist Volunteer Army moved from Dang E to Jiangla.

Jialequan Township governs the following areas: Jialequan Community, Tielugou Community, Yeyuan Village, Jutou Village, Nan Village, Xiang'erzu Village, Haojiaqu Village, Pando Village, Yangyan Village, Xingshuping Village, Fotangping Village, and Mingjiawa Village.

Longxi County was a county under the jurisdiction of Fujian Province in China. It was established during the Southern Dynasty. On August 15, 1960, Longxi County and Haicheng County were merged into Longhai County.

Kazusa Province, one of the ancient provinces of Japan under the Ritsuryō system, belonged to the Tōkaidō region, also known as Sōshū and Minami Kazusa. At the beginning of its establishment, the territory of Kazusa Province was approximately the central and southern part of present-day Chiba Prefecture, and later the southern part was separated and newly established as Awa Province.

Kumalibo is a town in Colombia, located in the eastern part of the country, under the jurisdiction of Bichada Province, adjacent to the border with Venezuela, with an area of 65,193 square kilometers, an altitude of 116 meters, and a population of 23,990 in 2005.

Wenjia Subdistrict is a township-level administrative area under the jurisdiction of Qingyang District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province, People's Republic of China, located in the west of Qingyang District. According to the data of 2006, the area of the jurisdiction is 20.25 square kilometers, with a population of 30,000.

The Division of Casey  is a lower house constituency in Victoria, Australia, located in the northeastern suburbs of the state capital, Melbourne. It covers an area of 409 square kilometers. The constituency was established in 1969 and is named in honor of the 16th Governor-General, Richard Casey. Since 1984, this area has been a safe seat for the Liberal Party. Since 2001, the local MP has been Tony Smith.
Junlian County is a county under the jurisdiction of Yibin City, Sichuan Province, China. The total area is 1254 square kilometers, and the population was 390,000 in 2002.

The Jiaozhi Governor's Office, renamed as the Jiaozhou Governor's Office at the end of the Eastern Han Dynasty, was one of the thirteen governor's offices of the Han Dynasty. The provincial capital was in Longbian County (now east of Hanoi, Vietnam), and moved to Guangxin County (now Wuzhou City, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region) at the end of the Eastern Han Dynasty. The scope of the Han Dynasty province roughly included today's Guangdong Province, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, most of Zhangzhou City in Fujian Province, as well as the northern and central parts of Vietnam.

The Pampas grasslands in the southern part of South America are vast, Argentina has a large number of ranches for cattle breeding, and a large amount of beef is exported every year. Therefore, Argentina is known as the "country riding on the back of a cow".

input: Qingling Town is located in Jiaohe City, Jilin City, Jilin Province, and is one of the larger granite raw material bases in the northeast. The proven reserves of granite are 280 million cubic meters. The very famous "Live Fish Street" is a food street featuring local aquatic products. There are more than 100 restaurants specializing in Qingling live fish, known as "China's No.1 Fish Meal Street".

Lake Mogan is a lake in Turkey, located in the central part of the country, 25 kilometers away from the capital Ankara, and is under the jurisdiction of Ankara Province. It is 14 kilometers long and 11 kilometers wide, with an area of 5.61 square kilometers, an altitude of 972 meters, and an average water depth of about 5 meters.

Songyuan County is a county in the southwestern part of Chongjin Road, Democratic People's Republic of Korea, adjacent to Ping'an North Road in the southwest. It is located in the upper reaches of the Zhongman River, with the Jiangnan Mountain Range  to the west and the Chongji Mountain in the middle. The area is 1,080 square kilometers, with a population of 38,051 in 2008. It is divided into 1 town, 1 worker's area, and 11 villages. The county was established in 1949.

input: Luzhi Town is a town in Wuzhong District, Suzhou, Jiangsu Province, China, covering an area of 50 square kilometers. The Luzhi Ancient Town area in the town is a national AAAA level tourist attraction, with a total area of about 4 square kilometers. In 2019, it ranked 85th among China's top 100 towns.
Tamil Nadu state in India is located in the southern part of the country, divided into 32 counties. Ariyalur County  and Tirupur County  are newly established counties.

Kudaira County is a county of the Shiribeshi General Promotion Bureau in Hokkaido, Japan, located in the central part of Shakotan Peninsula in the northwest of the Shiribeshi General Promotion Bureau. The name of the county comes from the Ainu language "hure-pira" , "hur-pira" , or "kur-pira" .

Boyanup is a small town located in the agricultural area of the Southwest region, beside the Southwest Highway in Western Australia. Boyanup is 195 kilometers south of Perth and 18 kilometers southeast of Bunbury. According to the 2006 census, the population of Boyanup is 615.

Skardu County is a county in the northern part of Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan. It is bordered by Astor County to the west, Gilgit County to the north, China to the northeast, Ghanche County to the east, and India to the south. The county seat is located in Skardu.

Kamijima County is a county of the Oshima General Promotion Bureau in Hokkaido, Japan, located in the southwest of the Oshima General Promotion Bureau. Because it is located on the coast northwest of Hakodate City (in Hokkaido, the west was once referred to as "up"), and the Japanese also call the coast "jima", it is therefore named "Kamijima".

Fuxi Village, an administrative village under the jurisdiction of Chaodong Town, Fuchuan Yao Autonomous County, Hezhou City, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. On December 17, 2012, it was listed in the Chinese Traditional Village Directory. The local residents are mainly Yao.

Nyeri (officially known as Nyeri Municipality) is a town in Kenya and is the administrative capital of the Central Province. The town is located about 150 kilometers north of Nairobi, the capital of Kenya (about 2 hours by car). In 1999, the most recent official census in Kenya showed that the population of the town was 98,908, but it is estimated that the population could grow to between 200,000 and 300,000 in the future.

Junlian County governs 7 towns, 2 townships, and 3 ethnic townships: Junlian Town, Tengda Town, Xunsi Town, Muai Town, Zhenzhou Town, Haoba Town, Daxueshan Town, Leyi Township, Tuanlin Miao Ethnic Township, Lianhe Miao Ethnic Township, Gaoping Miao Ethnic Township, and Fengle Township.

Bamei is a village in Guangnan County, Wenshan Zhuang and Miao Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, People's Republic of China, inhabited by the Zhuang people. Bamei is located in a basin surrounded by mountains, with no roads, and the transportation to the outside world must pass through two dark limestone karst caves about 1 kilometer long to reach Fali Village. The villagers maintain a traditional lifestyle and are known as a paradise.
